***Large Family Home***
***Two Reception Rooms***
***Large Rear Garden***

BYRNE MALONE are proud to bring 10 Kilbelin Close to the market by private Treaty. This impressive detached family home, ideally suited to modern family living and offering generous, well-proportioned accommodation throughout. The property is complemented by ample off-street parking to the front, a convenient side entrance and a large private rear garden. Ideally situated within walking distance of Whitewater Shopping Centre, excellent primary and secondary schools, restaurants, cafés, and a host of local amenities, you can enjoy an enviable level of convenience while retaining a peaceful residential setting. 

Upon entering, you are welcomed by a bright and spacious tiled entrance hallway. To the left a generously proportioned sitting room, featuring attractive timber flooring, a fuel-burning stove and a large picture window which floods the room with natural light, creating a warm and inviting space for relaxing. Continuing through the hallway, you arrive at the heart of the home ? a superb open-plan kitchen and dining area. The kitchen offers ample storage and workspace, with a central island providing an ideal focal point and additional preparation space. Tiled flooring flows throughout, while double doors from the dining area open directly onto the rear garden, making this a wonderful space for both everyday family life and entertaining.

From the kitchen, there is access to a large and practical utility room, providing excellent additional storage. This leads through to a second reception room/TV room, which features a striking feature wall, timber flooring and a log-burning stove, creating a cosy and comfortable space for family movie nights or relaxing evenings. A convenient downstairs WC completes the ground floor accommodation.

Upstairs, there are four bright and generously proportioned bedrooms. The spacious principal bedroom benefits from a private en-suite. The remaining bedrooms offer comfortable accommodation for family members or guests, while a fully tiled family bathroom completes the first-floor accommodation.

Outside, the property continues to impress with a large rear garden, offering plenty of space for children to play and for the whole family to enjoy. A generous patio area provides the perfect setting for outdoor dining, summer entertaining and family gatherings, while the side entrance offers excellent convenience and easy access to the rear garden.

This superb family home combines space, comfort, and an outstanding location, making it a rare opportunity in today's market.

Viewing is strongly recommended.
